facts.statement: The genus Lanzhousaurus was described by You, Ji, and Li in 2005.
facts.quote: Described by You, Ji, and Li in 2005

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus lived in the Gansu region of China during the Early Cretaceous (Barremian).
facts.quote: lived in the Gansu region of what is now China during the Early Cretaceous (Barremian)

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus is estimated to have been about 10 meters long and 6 tons in weight.
facts.quote: It has been estimated to be about 10 m in length and 6 t in weight

facts.statement: The only known species of Lanzhousaurus is Lanzhousaurus magnidens.
facts.quote: the type and only species is Lanzhousaurus magnidens

facts.statement: The species is known from a partial skeleton found in the Hekou Group.
facts.quote: known from a partial skeleton recovered from the Hekou Group

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus is described as having astonishingly huge teeth.
facts.quote: The genus has been described as having "astonishingly huge teeth"

facts.statement: The huge teeth indicate that Lanzhousaurus was a styracosternan iguanodont.
facts.quote: which indicate it was a styracosternan iguanodont

facts.statement: The mandible of Lanzhousaurus was longer than one meter, suggesting a very large size.
facts.quote: The mandible, longer than one meter, suggests a very large size for the animal

facts.statement: The tooth enamel of Lanzhousaurus grew very rapidly.
facts.quote: Tooth enamel of this dinosaur was growing very rapidly

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analyses recovered Lanzhousaurus as a non-hadrosauriform styracosternan member of the Ankylopollexia.
facts.quote: Lanzhousaurus was recovered as a non-hadrosauriform styracosternan member of the Ankylopollexia

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus lived at the beginning of the Cretaceous period, approximately 135 million years ago, during the Valanginian.
facts.quote: vivió a principios del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 135 millones de años, en el Valanginiense

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus lived in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: en lo que es hoy Asia

facts.statement: Fossils of Lanzhousaurus were found in the Lanzhou Bed in Gansu province, China.
facts.quote: Encontrado en el Lecho de Lanzhou, en la provincia de Gansu, en China

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus was a large bipedal herbivore approximately 10 meters long and weighing 4 tons.
facts.quote: Lanzhousaurus, fue un gran herbívoro bípedo de aproximadamente 10 metros de largo y un peso de 4 toneladas

facts.statement: The teeth of Lanzhousaurus reached 14 centimeters in length on a lower jaw that was 1 meter long.
facts.quote: Sus dientes llegaron a medir 14 centímetros en una la mandíbula inferior de 1 metro de largo

facts.statement: These teeth are the largest discovered in a known herbivorous dinosaur.
facts.quote: Estos dientes son los más grandes descubiertos en un dinosaurio herbívoro conocido

facts.statement: Along with Lurdusaurus from Niger, Lanzhousaurus represents a previously unknown lineage of massively built quadrupedal ornithopods.
facts.quote: Junto con Lurdusaurus, un dinosaurio de Níger, ambas especies representan un linaje de ornitópodos cuadrúpedos masivamente construidos, previamente desconocido

facts.statement: This discovery implies a close connection between Eurasia and Africa during the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Este descubrimiento también implica una conexión cercana entre Eurasia y África durante el Cretácico temprano

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus differs from other iguanodontids by possessing large individual teeth and a small number of them.
facts.quote: Lanzhousaurus es diferente del resto de los iguanodóntidos en poseer dientes individuales grandes y un número pequeño de los mismos

facts.statement: Lanzhousaurus possessed compressed metacarpals II and IV.
facts.quote: los metacarpos II y IV comprimidos

facts.statement: The neural spines on the back were moderately high, giving it a low profile at the hips.
facts.quote: Las espinas neurales de la espalda son moderadamente alta, lo que le da un perfil bajo en la cruz

facts.statement: The time range for Lanzhousaurus is from the Barremian to the Aptian (125.77 to 113.2 million years ago).
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Lanzhousaurus is Styracosterna.
facts.quote: Parent group: Styracosterna
